adaptation.method: per-action contact-aware retargeting; no global pose scale
requiredChanges: Source bottom leg is generated from old TH/SH and REST hip; reconstruct hip/knee/ankle chain at original joint directions with current segment lengths.
Recalculate left support elbow/hand from current waist/shoulder transform; source EL was derived from old WR/REST.
Hip touch bisection must target the current visible surface rather than count solver success as contact.
adaptation.handAcceptance: This action has not been visually inspected with the selected body/hand setup.
adaptation.implemented: Recomputed free bottom leg with current lengths and upper-body support geometry from current waist; right hand surface target follows hip rest offset.
adaptation.rotationPolicy: Full forearm axial sharing avoids half-angle +/-pi branch flips; actual-render rotation and visible deformation checks remain required.
adaptation.userHandFeedback: 2026-10-29: retain movement and framing, relax and flatten both hands; align authored distal directions with actual forearms rather than forcing the right hand across its forearm.

reviewPlan.primaryView: A somewhat lower lateral view separates the working lower leg from the bent support leg.
checks: Left forearm/elbow support, right foot support and right hand-to-hip contact are visible.
Bottom left leg lifts with a nearly straight knee and returns without floor penetration.
Side view separates lower leg from upper planted leg and shows hip stacking.
Inspect actual wrist and ankle quaternion paths at every frame, not only endpoint directions: shortest consecutive rotation, total turn, hand/sole facing, left/right consistency and loop seam.
Review both relaxed hand shapes and palmar floor/body clearance in close-up; r5 changes hand descriptors only.
reviewPlan.contentBounds: union of visible body and necessary props over all output frames; one rectangle for the whole clip
reviewPlan.groundProps: Keep necessary support mat/wall/cushion as explicit props; exclude shadow/stage helpers.

limits: This checks authored descriptor vectors and raw foot angles. It does not measure actual wrist/ankle bone quaternions, IK pole branch changes or skinned twists.
Large raw Euler angles or identical endpoint orientations alone do not establish a defect. Root GPU capture must inspect actual continuous rotations.

risks: The original hip-touch bisection is retained and is not a native surface-contact proof.
Support forearm/foot, head alignment and lower-leg clearance require GPU review.
Current body retains v3 legs/trunk; changing the runtime label alone does not retarget old absolute coordinates.
Support, relaxed, assist and non-dumbbell native grips require their own rendered checks; fixed dumbbell acceptance does not apply.

appearance.purpose: Visual cue for target muscle effort, not a physiological measurement
